_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The 4% base rate for meaningful 12h score moves makes HOLD the statistically honest default in this coil, even with a strong bottom analog — the breaker requires fear_greed above 30 with tame funding to justify a directional commitment.
next_move.brains_agree: Split — analyst calls HOLD with medium conviction citing coil statistics; narrative implicitly leans UP on accumulation thesis but does not specify a trigger
next_move.confirmed_if: fear_greed breaks above 30 while BTC holds above $63k and funding stays below 0.015%
next_move.invalidated_if: fear_greed drops below 20 with VIX spiking above 20 and funding turning negative
